description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'DownloadsRootScreen', which displays a list of download items with controls to pause/resume, remove downloads, and shows a placeholder when there are no downloads. It uses provider for state management and interacts with a DownloadController.

classes.name: DownloadsRootScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that serves as the main screen for displaying downloads, with controls for pausing, resuming, and removing downloads.

classes.name: _EmptyDownloads
classes.description: A private widget shown when there are no downloads, providing user guidance.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for both 'DownloadsRootScreen' and '_EmptyDownloads', defining UI layout and behavior.
